result.instructions: Tools for Hub Planner, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show active projects and the people assigned to them."; "Find bookings overlapping next week."; "Compare the booked time and actual time entries for a project.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Hub Planner data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run hubplanner_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run hubplanner_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run hubplanner_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. hubplanner_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: hubplanner_create_time_entry
tools.description: WRITE: Create a time entry for a resource and project on one date. Requires a Read & Write API key. This records actual worked time and can affect reports and billing; verify details first. No automatic retries.
